_frames_end: Last frame tracked. Remove this key once img012604.tif exists in imgFile_mask.
_tracking_changes: Your choices of 11 Oct 2026 (report section 12, tests U0-U6): short tracks link within 5 voxels instead of tracerConfig.txt's 30, in every run; the 15-35 Hz runs use the finder thresholds of I5's second row (matched to 35Hz_r_b_1 at 30, tests/propose_thresholds.txt), the 10 Hz runs keep tracerConfig.txt's 20. make_configs.py applies both to the batch's configs.
